disclaimer: Domain knowledge, not legal advice. Confirm applicability per jurisdiction with a qualified reviewer.

items.name: FERPA — Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act
items.scope: Protects the privacy of student education records; governs disclosure and grants parents/eligible students access rights.
items.notes: Applies to US institutions receiving federal funding.

items.name: COPPA — Children's Online Privacy Protection Act
items.scope: Requires verifiable parental consent before collecting personal information from children under 13.
items.notes: Directly relevant to K-12-oriented products with student accounts.

items.name: GDPR — general processing and children's data (Art. 8)
items.scope: General data protection plus Article 8's special conditions for a child's consent to information-society services.
items.notes: Applies whenever an EU/EEA data subject's data is processed, regardless of operator location.

items.name: Web accessibility (WCAG 2.1/2.2, Section 508)
items.jurisdiction: Global standard; legally mandated in US (Section 508, ADA Title II for public institutions) and EU (EN 301 549)
items.scope: LMS/content must be perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust for learners with disabilities.
items.notes: Frequently a procurement/accreditation requirement for public and higher-ed institutions.

items.name: Academic integrity / anti-plagiarism policy
items.scope: Institutional policy on cheating, plagiarism, and AI-assisted work; drives plagiarism-detection feature requirements.
items.notes: Not a legal regulation; included because it directly shapes feature requirements and is commonly conflated with compliance.
